name: FullDiodeModels
_comment_en: Diode small-signal template - Full level (Analog Insydes FullDiodeSmallSignal, simp==0). Basic plus the series ohmic RS: R_s between the true anode A and the internal node AS, with the small-signal core (R_eq and C_d) across AS-C. When RS != 0 the AS node materialises; when RS is absent/0 the degeneracy cleanup shorts A to AS and the model collapses to Basic. RS is read from the .out Diode MODEL PARAMETERS table; value resolution in netlist/Model.py._diode_ac_param_values (RS/AREA).
